name: Gaurav Singh
title: Full-Stack Developer & AI/ML Builder
tagline: I build scalable web applications and ML-driven systems, from React interfaces and FastAPI services to anomaly detection pipelines.
intro: Computer Science undergraduate at AKGEC who designs and ships end-to-end products: responsive frontends, REST APIs, and ML pipelines. I enjoy working close to the fundamentals, from data structures to operating systems.
headline: Building end-to-end products, from thoughtful interfaces to applied machine learning.
about:
I’m a second-year B.Tech Computer Science Engineering student at Ajay Kumar Garg Engineering College (AKGEC), with a CGPA of 8.1. I build full-stack applications using React, Vite, and FastAPI, and explore machine learning applications such as anomaly detection for public-fund monitoring. I take part in hackathon projects, including Smart India Hackathon problem statements, and enjoy taking ideas from problem analysis toward a working prototype.

I’m a self-directed learner who likes understanding systems from first principles. I study data structures and algorithms in C and C++, computer organization and architecture, and operating-system concepts through resources such as MIT 6.S081. I prefer iterating in small steps, keeping solutions simple, and being precise about what a system does—and what it does not do.

projects.name: Kisan Setu · SIH26032
projects.status: Farmer queue prototype · other modules to confirm
projects.description: An agricultural-tech project for Smart India Hackathon problem SIH26032. The detailed prototype centers on a farmer-facing digital token and queue; the project scope also includes an admin dashboard and transportation tracking to coordinate movement between farmers and procurement centers.

projects.name: MPLADS AI Monitoring Platform
projects.status: Interactive HTML prototypes built · ML pipeline proposed
projects.description: Several interactive HTML prototypes explore drill-down project views, spending indicators, and escalation flows for monitoring MPLADS fund usage. A future analysis pipeline is proposed—Isolation Forest for anomalies, TF-IDF clustering for similar project text, gradient-boosted regression for estimates, and graph analysis for vendor concentration; these ML components are not presented as implemented.

projects.name: AYUSH Health Portal · AyuMedic
projects.status: React/Vite + FastAPI setup and debugging · features planned
projects.description: A healthcare platform being set up and debugged locally on Windows. The planned experience covers patient signup and verification, provider discovery by location and filters, health-issue search, appointment slots, provider licence verification, and hospital booking workflows. These are plans, not claims that the features are already shipped.

projects.name: INKWELL · Folio Resume Builder
projects.description: A resume builder delivered as a single self-contained HTML file using vanilla JavaScript. It has a full multi-step wizard, a template gallery, simulated authentication, and an earlier landing-page concept with CSS-based 3D animation.

projects.name: Consent-Based Face Recognition System
projects.status: Minimal webcam script started · backend/dashboard planned
projects.description: A consent-based face-recognition experiment inspired by a fictional tracking interface. It began as a minimal webcam script using OpenCV and face_recognition; a FastAPI backend and web dashboard are future plans. Enrollment is intended only for people who explicitly consent.

projects.name: Personal Portfolio
projects.status: React + Vite frontend and FastAPI backend
projects.description: This portfolio brings together profile content, project and learning sections, a contact form, and a locally served profile API. CSS-built motion and scenes provide the visual experience; Java is a technology of interest, not part of this site's current stack.

projects.name: Smaller Builds & Experiments
projects.status: Local setup, exploration, prototypes, and concept work
projects.description: A collection of smaller efforts: an OTP login setup explored with Node.js, Twilio, Redis, and JWT; a browser code-playground exploration for Python, JavaScript, and HTML/CSS; a multi-stage upload/storefront in a single HTML file; and an AI control-layer pitch concept. These have different levels of completion and are not represented as one shipped product.
